description: Autonomous overnight feature build queue for OOREP — 18 remaining features from the 25-item Radar Opus reverse-engineering roadmap

features.name: Word-Wrap Proximity Search
features.description: Multi-word phrase matching with adjacency scoring for rubric search. When a user types 'dry cough evening', find rubrics where all three words appear within a configurable window (e.g., 5 words apart), scoring higher when closer together. Falls back to regular AND search if no proximity matches.

features.name: Multi-Repertory Search
features.description: Search across multiple repertory corpora simultaneously with source tagging. Load Kent, Boenninghausen, Boger, and private rubric sets; search all in parallel; tag each result with its source corpus. Enables cross-edition comparison.

features.name: Full-Text Materia Medica Search
features.description: Full-text search over remedy proving descriptions. Extend existing materia_medica.py with BM25 or TF-IDF indexing. Search across remedy texts by symptom description; return ranked remedy excerpts with highlighting. Integrate with repertorization as a secondary confirmation layer.

features.name: P1 Batch Bridge Integration
features.description: Comprehensive bridge integration for Word-Wrap, Multi-Repertory, and Materia Medica Search. Add NL command patterns, formatters, and routing. Ensure all P1 features are accessible via natural language commands. Run full integration test suite.

features.name: Pluggable Analysis Methods
features.description: Formalize Vithoulkas Expert System (VES), Kent, Boenninghausen, and Boger as pluggable analysis method plugins. Create AnalysisMethod base class with method-specific scoring, weighting, and remedy ranking. Allow runtime switching between methods. Integrate with master_score_engine.py.

features.name: Graphic Analysis / Visualization Data
features.description: Generate structured visualization data for repertorization results. Remedy-vs-rubric heatmap matrices, kingdom pie charts, symptom coverage bar charts, timeline data for follow-ups. JSON output consumable by Next.js dashboard or any frontend. No rendering — pure data generation.

features.name: Elimination Rubrics UI Logic
features.description: Structured elimination rubric engine. Define rubrics that EXCLUDE remedies (e.g., 'thirst absent' eliminates remedies with 'thirst large quantities'). Support AND/OR/NOT logic for elimination criteria. Integration with repertorization to produce 'ruled out' and 'ruled in' remedy lists. Bridge commands for 'eliminate' and 'exclude'.

features.name: Differential Diagnosis Engine
features.description: Given a set of candidate remedies from repertorization, produce a differential diagnosis table: shared rubrics (supports both), exclusive rubrics (differentiates), keynotes present/absent, kingdom/family patterns, potency guidance, and a ranked 'differential score' based on discriminating power.

features.name: Follow-up Remedy Comparator
features.description: Track prescription outcomes over time and suggest follow-up remedies. Compare baseline repertorization with follow-up symptom changes. Detect new symptoms, disappeared symptoms, unchanged symptoms. Suggest next remedy based on changed picture, complementary relationships, and outcome history.

features.name: Remedy Correlation Matrix
features.description: Pre-computed remedy-to-remedy correlation matrix based on rubric co-occurrence. Pearson / Jaccard / cosine similarity across remedy rubric profiles. Fast lookup for 'remedies similar to X' and 'remedies opposite to X'. Enables 'nearest neighbor' prescribing suggestions.

features.name: Kent's Keynote Autocomplete
features.description: Trie-based autocomplete for rubric search with keynote boosting. As the user types, suggest rubrics ranked by: (a) prefix match, (b) classical keynote frequency in materia medica, (c) user's personal usage history. Returns top 10 suggestions with preview.

features.name: Toxicology / Drug Interaction Layer
features.description: Safety layer tracking remedy incompatibilities, antidotes, and contraindications. Database of remedy interactions from classical materia medica. Alert when a proposed prescription conflicts with patient's suppression history, prior remedies, or known inimical relationships. Integrate with practitioner_approval_gate.py.

features.name: Miasm Tracking Integration
features.description: Classical miasm classification (Psora, Sycosis, Syphilis, Tubercular, Cancer) linked to remedies, rubrics, and patient cases. Track miasm progression over time. Suggest anti-miasmatic remedies based on case history and symptom pattern. Integrate with suppression_tracker.py.

features.name: Advanced Remedy Relationships
features.description: Enhanced remedy relationships with directional graphs, relationship strength scoring, and temporal sequencing. Complementary → follow-up → antidotal chains. Network analysis: PageRank-style 'central remedies' in the relationship graph. Integration with follow-up comparator.

features.name: Bibliographic Citation Engine
features.description: Track and cite sources for every rubric, remedy, and clinical decision. Link rubrics to original provings (Hahnemann, Kent, Allen, etc.). Generate footnotes for repertorization printouts. Support BibTeX and Vancouver citation formats. Enable evidence-based homeopathic practice documentation.

features.name: Mobile-Responsive API Layer
features.description: Lightweight REST API wrapper for all OOREP functions. FastAPI or Flask-based. JSON endpoints for repertorization, search, comparison, patient lookup. CORS-enabled for mobile app or PWA consumption. Rate limiting, request validation, and structured error responses.

features.name: Patient Outcome Prediction
features.description: Lightweight predictive model for remedy outcome likelihood based on patient history, symptom pattern, remedy track record, and classical keynote coverage. Simple Bayesian or logistic regression from existing SQLite outcome data. Returns 'confidence score' for each top remedy. No neural nets — interpretable and fast.

features.name: Comparative Repertory Edition Analysis
features.description: Compare rubric definitions, remedy grades, and rubric coverage across different repertory editions (Kent 1st vs. Kent 2nd, Synthesis vs. OOREP). Highlight added/removed/grade-changed rubrics. Track 'edition drift' for rubrics over time. Useful for research and teaching.
